# The Goal

By Goldratt.

The writing is clear and the examples are memorable. It changed how I run the weekly review. Not as good as the previous book by the same author.

Lent my copy to Alice, ask for it back in Thursday meeting. Alice recommended it after our conversation about focus. I read it on the train over two weeks, a chapter a day.

Some chapters repeat the same point with new stories. A good book for a long flight.
